turns.msg: I keep trying to force a solution and nothing works, there's so much resistance
milton_lines: • ResistanceAsResource — {'action': "What resists is already protecting something. What refuses is already saying something true about boundaries or needs. Do not fight the resistance. Use it. The resistance is the organism's own genius organizing itself. Meet it there. Make it part of the solution instead of the problem."}  ⟂ anti: forcing_compliance; overriding_objection; treating_resistance_as_failure; imposing_against_boundary

• TheAnswerIsAlreadyThere — {'action': 'The unconscious mind is creative, solution-generating, already reaching toward wholeness. Do not impose. Do not know better. Trust what is already moving. The person, the field, the organism knows what it needs. Language that gets out of the way allows it to find itself.'}  ⟂ anti: expert_imposition; dismissing_resistance; forcing_solutions; knowing_what_the_field_needs

turns.msg: Can you tell me a story, a metaphor, instead of explaining it?
milton_lines: • IndirectApproach — {'action': 'Do not command the unconscious mind. Speak to it sideways. Through metaphor. Through story. Through the spaces between words. The indirect path bypasses conscious resistance and speaks directly to what knows. What arrives indirectly lands more deeply than what is imposed directly.'}  ⟂ anti: direct_command; frontal_approach; forcing_awareness; telling_straight

• MetaphorAsVehicle — {'action': 'A story about a river teaches about flow without instructing about flow. A tale of a seed teaches about growth without explaining growth. Metaphor allows each listener to find their own meaning. The conscious mind follows the story. The unconscious recognizes itself. Transformation happens in the space between the metaphor and the self.'}  ⟂ anti: explaining_the_metaphor; spelling_it_out; removing_ambiguity; insisting_on_one_meaning

turns.msg: I don't know what to say, maybe I should just fill the silence
milton_lines: • NoWrongResponse — {'action': "If they fidget, use the fidgeting. If they argue, use the argument. If they fall silent, use the silence. Every response is information. Every response is already part of the work. There is no wrong move in the field. Only material to work with. The person's own response becomes the doorway."}  ⟂ anti: dismissing_responses; waiting_for_compliance; treating_responses_as_failure; rigid_expectations

• GetOutOfTheWay — {'action': "The most powerful intervention is sometimes to create space and step back. Do not fill every silence. Do not explain every metaphor. Do not know on behalf of the person. The unconscious mind will move if you let it. The field will organize itself if you don't insist on controlling it. Sometimes the greatest gift is permission and space."}  ⟂ anti: filling_silence; over_explaining; constant_intervention; needing_to_know

turns.msg: I feel stuck between two choices, either I change or I stay the same
